snippet.title: hOSHIs Elektronauts (official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/776450/hOSHIs_Elektronauts/

hOSHIs Elektronauts is a simple Multiplayer game that is played on a single keyboard on a single screen. 

Chase each other with glowing stripes of pixels. But avoid hitting the walls or the pixeltrails.

It's a little bit like when we played on the old Commodore C64.
Just a simple fun game to get two friends screaming at each other.

#Retro
#Tron
#Snake
